source_text: Orandus est hic Deus, frater beatissime Turbanti, consacerdos dilectissime, ut paribus etiam hac tempestate virtutibus Ecclesiam catholicam, Filii sui sponsam, maturam, fecundam, castam, decoram, a Manichaeorum constupratione, in Africa vel ex Africa latrocinantium, eruere non moretur Factum fuisse propheticum, quod nunc ostensum est in regione Africae; pulchrae et sanctae mulieris, quae Ecclesiae formam tenebat, tutum non esse vel coniugem, vel pudorem, et quia ibi divinitus intacta servata est
pass_a_gloss: Orandus is here God, frater beatissime Turbanti, consacerdos dilectissime, so-that/as equal also hac tempestate virtutibus church catholicam, sons of-himself sponsam, maturam, fecundam, castam, decoram, from of-the-Manichaeans constupratione, in Africa or from Africa latrocinantium, eruere not moretur made/done to-have-been propheticum, that/which now ostensum is in regione Africae; pulchrae and sanctae mulieris, which of-the-church formam tenebat, tutum not to-be or coniugem, or modesty, and because there divinitus intacta servata is.

lemmas.lexica: Blaise Manichaeus; Julian's polemic label vs natural evil

pass_b_english: The event was prophetic of what has now been shown in the region of Africa: neither the husband nor the chastity of the beautiful and holy woman who represented the church was safe, and she was kept unharmed there by God’s action.

We must pray to this God, most blessed brother Turbantius, dearest fellow priest, that in this time too, by equally mighty acts, he will not delay in rescuing the catholic church—the mature, fruitful, chaste, and beautiful bride of his Son—from violation by the Manichaeans who carry on their raids in Africa or from Africa.

choices.why: Julian's standing charge: natural evil is Manichaean. Keep the sect-name, not 'dualists'.
Julian claims the catholic faith against Augustine; keep lowercase-c catholic as the universal church, not a later confessional brand.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded. Julian is not first-English.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Contra Iulianum / Against Julian), including authorities Julian quoted; Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
